text: Which of the following is a social developmental need of adolescents?
explanation: Adolescents strongly need belonging and acceptance among peers.

text: Which method of studying adolescents records their natural behaviour in real settings?
explanation: Naturalistic observation watches behaviour as it occurs in daily settings.

text: A student who refuses to accept that he has failed an examination is using the defence mechanism of:
explanation: Denial refuses to accept an unpleasant reality.

text: The most suitable school response to an adolescent with serious emotional problems is:
explanation: Counselling helps the adolescent understand and solve the problem.

text: In Freud's structure of personality, the part that follows the reality principle is the:
explanation: The id follows the pleasure principle, the ego the reality principle, the superego morality.

text: The "good boy, nice girl" orientation in Kohlberg's theory belongs to the:
explanation: Seeking approval from others is a conventional-level stage.

text: Erikson's crisis of "intimacy versus isolation" occurs mainly in:
explanation: Young adults form close relationships or become isolated.

text: At the top of Maslow's hierarchy of needs is:
explanation: Self-actualisation, fulfilment of one's potential, is the highest need.

text: Which of the following is a subjective factor that determines attention?
explanation: Interest, attitude and motives lie within the person; size, loudness and movement are objective.

text: Transfer of training from one hand to the other is called:
explanation: Bilateral transfer is the carry-over of skill from one side of the body to the other.

text: Which classroom practice best fosters creativity?
options: Asking open-ended questions and accepting varied answers
Insisting on a single correct answer
explanation: Open-ended tasks and a safe atmosphere encourage original thinking.

text: The relationship between creativity and intelligence is generally:
explanation: Research shows a positive but modest relationship.

text: When a dog trained to salivate at a bell of one pitch also salivates at bells of similar pitches, this is called:
explanation: Generalisation is responding to stimuli similar to the conditioned stimulus.

text: Thorndike's law of readiness states that learning is best when the learner is:
explanation: Readiness, physical and mental, makes learning satisfying and effective.

text: Ausubel stressed that the most important factor in learning is:
options: The length of the school day
explanation: Ausubel's meaningful learning builds on the learner's existing knowledge.

text: Mental retardation is generally associated with an IQ below about:
explanation: An IQ below about 70 with deficits in adaptive behaviour is the usual criterion.

text: Which of the following supports the inclusion of children with locomotor disabilities in a regular school?
explanation: Barrier-free access is a basic requirement of inclusion.

text: The main aim of teaching is to bring about:
options: Desirable changes in the learner's behaviour
explanation: Teaching aims at desirable changes in knowledge, skills and attitudes.

text: A teacher who sets goals and inspires pupils to work towards them is acting as a:
explanation: A leader gives direction and inspires group effort.

text: Which of the following is a factor affecting teaching?
options: The colour of the school gate
The teacher's subject knowledge and communication skill
explanation: Teacher competence and communication strongly affect teaching.

text: A norm-referenced test compares a student's performance with that of:
explanation: Norm-referenced tests rank students against a group.

text: Peer assessment means:
explanation: Learners give feedback on each other's work using criteria.

text: Which of the following is an effective use of ICT in the classroom?
options: Showing simulations and animations of scientific processes
explanation: Simulations make abstract ideas visible and interactive.

text: Which of the following reduces idle time and misbehaviour in the classroom?
explanation: Good planning keeps pupils engaged.

text: Commitment of a teacher to the profession is shown by:
options: Private tuition for own students at school time
Punctuality, preparation and care for learners
explanation: Dedicated work and care for pupils show professional commitment.

text: The report "Learning Without Burden" was submitted in:
explanation: The Yash Pal Committee submitted it in 1993 to reduce curriculum load.

text: Article 21A of the Constitution of India provides for:
options: Free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14
explanation: The 86th Amendment inserted Article 21A.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “കൃഷി നമ്മുടെ നാടിന്റെ നട്ടെല്ലാണ്. കർഷകൻ വിയർപ്പൊഴുക്കുമ്പോഴാണ് നമ്മുടെ തീൻമേശയിൽ ആഹാരമെത്തുന്നത്. എന്നിട്ടും കർഷകന്റെ ജീവിതം പലപ്പോഴും കഷ്ടത്തിലാണ്.” ഈ ഭാഗത്തിൽ നിന്ന് മനസ്സിലാക്കാവുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
options: നമുക്ക് ആഹാരം നൽകുന്ന കർഷകരുടെ ജീവിതം പലപ്പോഴും കഷ്ടത്തിലാണ്
explanation: ഖണ്ഡികയുടെ അവസാനവാക്യം കർഷകരുടെ കഷ്ടത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് പറയുന്നു.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഗുരുവിനോടുള്ള ബഹുമാനം വിദ്യാർഥിയുടെ ആദ്യത്തെ ഗുണമാണ്. ബഹുമാനമുള്ളവർക്ക് മാത്രമേ അറിവ് ഉള്ളിൽ ഉറയ്ക്കൂ.” ഖണ്ഡിക അനുസരിച്ച് അറിവ് ഉള്ളിൽ ഉറയ്ക്കുന്നത് ആർക്കാണ്?
explanation: ‘ബഹുമാനമുള്ളവർക്ക് മാത്രമേ അറിവ് ഉള്ളിൽ ഉറയ്ക്കൂ’ എന്ന് ഖണ്ഡികയിൽ പറയുന്നു.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ദേശസ്നേഹം എന്നാൽ നമ്മുടെ നാടിനെ സ്നേഹിക്കുകയും അതിന്റെ പുരോഗതിക്കായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുക എന്നതാണ്. വെറും മുദ്രാവാക്യങ്ങൾ വിളിക്കുന്നതിൽ അത് ഒതുങ്ങുന്നില്ല.” ദേശസ്നേഹത്തെ ലേഖകൻ എങ്ങനെ വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു?
explanation: നാടിനെ സ്നേഹിക്കുകയും പുരോഗതിക്കായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യലാണ് ദേശസ്നേഹം എന്ന് ഖണ്ഡിക പറയുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “മഴ വന്നു മണ്ണിൻ മണം പൊങ്ങി, മയിലുകൾ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു; കുട്ടികൾ കൂട്ടമായ് മുറ്റത്തിറങ്ങി, കളിവള്ളം തോട്ടിലൊഴുക്കി.” ഈ വരികൾ ഏത് കാലത്തെ വർണിക്കുന്നു?
explanation: ‘മഴ വന്നു’, ‘കളിവള്ളം തോട്ടിലൊഴുക്കി’ എന്നീ പ്രയോഗങ്ങൾ മഴക്കാലത്തെ കാണിക്കുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “മഴ വന്നു മണ്ണിൻ മണം പൊങ്ങി, മയിലുകൾ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു.” മഴ വന്നപ്പോൾ മയിലുകൾ എന്തു ചെയ്തു?
explanation: വരിയിൽ ‘മയിലുകൾ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു’ എന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “കുട്ടികൾ കൂട്ടമായ് മുറ്റത്തിറങ്ങി, കളിവള്ളം തോട്ടിലൊഴുക്കി.” ഇവിടെ കുട്ടികളുടെ മാനസികാവസ്ഥ എന്താണ്?
explanation: കൂട്ടമായി ഇറങ്ങി കളിവള്ളമൊഴുക്കുന്നത് സന്തോഷത്തെ കാണിക്കുന്നു.

text: ‘പുഷ്പം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ പര്യായമല്ലാത്തത് ഏത്?
explanation: പൂവ്, സുമം, കുസുമം എന്നിവ പുഷ്പത്തിന്റെ പര്യായങ്ങളാണ്.

text: ‘ഉയർച്ച’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതപദം ഏത്?
explanation: ഉയർച്ചയുടെ വിപരീതം താഴ്ചയാണ്.

text: ‘വേദം അറിയുന്നവൻ’ എന്നതിന് ഒറ്റപ്പദം ഏത്?
explanation: വേദം അറിയുന്നവൻ വേദജ്ഞൻ.

text: ‘വരുക’ എന്ന ക്രിയയുടെ ഭൂതകാലരൂപം ഏത്?
explanation: ഭൂതകാലത്തിൽ ‘വന്നു’ എന്ന രൂപം വരുന്നു.

text: ‘പുസ്തകം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ ബഹുവചനം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘പുസ്തകം’ ന്റെ ബഹുവചനം ‘പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ’.

text: ഉചിതമായ പദം ചേർത്ത് പൂരിപ്പിക്കുക: “കഠിനാധ്വാനം ചെയ്താൽ വിജയം ......”
explanation: കഠിനാധ്വാനം വിജയത്തിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുമെന്ന് അർഥം.

text: ‘വരൂ’ എന്ന പദം ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുന്ന വാക്യത്തിൽ ഏത് അർഥമാണ് വ്യക്തമാകുന്നത്?
explanation: ‘വരൂ’ എന്നത് ക്ഷണിക്കുന്നതോ അഭ്യർഥിക്കുന്നതോ ആയ രൂപമാണ്.

text: മലയാളത്തിലെ ചില്ലക്ഷരങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണം (ൺ, ൻ, ർ, ൽ, ൾ) എത്ര?
explanation: ണ്‍, ന്‍, ര്‍, ല്‍, ള്‍ എന്നിങ്ങനെ അഞ്ച് ചില്ലക്ഷരങ്ങളാണ് സാധാരണയായി പറയുന്നത്.

text: ‘ച’ വർഗത്തിലെ അനുനാസികം ഏത്?
explanation: ച വർഗം: ച ഛ ജ ഝ ഞ; ഇതിലെ അനുനാസികം ‘ഞ’.

text: ‘അവനാൽ’ എന്ന പദം ഏത് വിഭക്തിയിൽപ്പെടുന്നു?
explanation: ‘-ആൽ’ പ്രത്യയം പ്രയോജിക വിഭക്തിയുടേതാണ്.

text: ‘മുതലക്കണ്ണീർ ഒഴുക്കുക’ എന്ന ശൈലിയുടെ അർഥം ഏത്?
explanation: ഉള്ളിൽ ദുഃഖമില്ലാതെ കരയുന്നതായി ഭാവിക്കുക എന്നാണ് ഇതിന്റെ അർഥം.

text: ‘ചൂടുവെള്ളത്തിൽ വീണ പൂച്ച പച്ചവെള്ളത്തെ പേടിക്കും’ എന്ന പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലിന്റെ ആശയം ഏത്?
options: ഒരിക്കൽ ദുരനുഭവം ഉണ്ടായവർ ചെറിയ കാര്യങ്ങളെപ്പോലും ഭയക്കും
explanation: മുൻ അനുഭവത്തിന്റെ ഭയം സമാനമായ ചെറിയ കാര്യങ്ങളിലും ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നാണ് ഇതിന്റെ ആശയം.

text: ‘ഖസാക്കിന്റെ ഇതിഹാസം’ എന്ന നോവൽ രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: ഖസാക്കിന്റെ ഇതിഹാസം ഒ. വി. വിജയന്റെ കൃതിയാണ്.

text: ‘രമണൻ’ എന്ന കാവ്യം രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: രമണൻ ചങ്ങമ്പുഴയുടെ പ്രശസ്ത കാവ്യമാണ്.

text: The minimum distance between a source of sound and a reflecting wall for an echo to be heard clearly is about (speed of sound 340 m/s, persistence of hearing 0.1 s):
explanation: The sound must travel to the wall and back in 0.1 s: distance = 340 x 0.1 / 2 = 17 m.

text: Sound waves of frequency below 20 Hz are called:
explanation: Infrasound lies below the audible range of 20 Hz to 20 kHz.

text: The refractive index of a medium is 2. The critical angle for light going from this medium to air is:
When white light passes through a glass prism, the colour that deviates the least is:
explanation: Red has the longest wavelength and bends least.

text: Capillary rise of a liquid is greater in a tube of:
explanation: Rise h = 2T cos(theta)/(r rho g), so a smaller radius gives a greater rise.

text: Transfer of heat in liquids and gases by the actual movement of the particles is called:
explanation: Convection currents carry heat in fluids.

text: A car travels 60 km in 2 hours. Its average speed is:
explanation: Average speed = total distance / total time = 60 / 2 = 30 km/h.

text: Passengers in a bus fall forward when it stops suddenly. This is explained by:
explanation: The body tends to continue in its state of motion.

text: A solar eclipse occurs when the:
options: Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon
Sun comes between the Earth and the Moon
Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth
explanation: The Moon's shadow falls on the Earth during a solar eclipse.

text: One kilowatt-hour is equal to:
An electric heater is rated 220 V and draws 5 A. Its power is:
A fuse wire is made of a material having:
explanation: A low melting point lets it melt and break the circuit when the current is too high.

text: An electroscope is used to:
options: Detect the presence of electric charge
explanation: The leaves of a gold-leaf electroscope diverge when charged.

text: A solenoid carrying current behaves like:
explanation: The magnetic field of a current-carrying solenoid resembles that of a bar magnet.

text: The split ring (commutator) in a DC generator is used to:
options: Reverse the connections to the external circuit every half rotation to give direct current
explanation: The commutator keeps the output current in one direction.

text: How many diodes are used in a bridge rectifier?
explanation: A full-wave bridge rectifier uses four diodes.

text: With a rise in temperature, the resistance of a semiconductor generally:
explanation: More carriers are released at higher temperature, so resistance falls.

text: Dissolving quicklime (calcium oxide) in water is:
explanation: Slaking of lime releases a large amount of heat.

text: An element with electronic configuration 2, 8, 1 has a valency of:
explanation: It has one electron in its outer shell, which it loses easily.

text: The neutron was discovered by:
explanation: James Chadwick discovered the neutron in 1932.

text: Sodium is stored under kerosene because it:
options: Is very reactive with air and water
explanation: Sodium reacts vigorously with oxygen and moisture.

text: Rust is chiefly:
explanation: Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide, Fe₂O₃.xH₂O.

text: Fog is a colloid in which:
options: A gas is dispersed in a liquid
A liquid is dispersed in a gas
A solid is dispersed in a gas
A solid is dispersed in a liquid
explanation: Fog is an aerosol of tiny water droplets in air.

text: The different components of petroleum are separated by:
explanation: Components with different boiling points are collected in different fractions.

text: Lithium, sodium and potassium belong to the group of:
explanation: Group 1 elements are the alkali metals.

text: In the modern periodic table, metals are found mainly on the:
explanation: Metals occupy the left and centre; non-metals the right.

text: According to the octet rule, atoms tend to combine so as to have how many electrons in their outermost shell?
explanation: Atoms gain, lose or share electrons to attain eight electrons in the outer shell.

text: Chlorine is widely used for:
explanation: Chlorination kills germs in water.

text: The hardest natural substance, an allotrope of carbon, is:
explanation: In diamond every carbon atom is bonded tetrahedrally to four others.

text: The molecular formula of ethane is:
explanation: Ethane is the alkane with two carbon atoms: C₂H₆.

text: The common name of sodium hydrogencarbonate is:
explanation: NaHCO₃ is baking soda; washing soda is Na₂CO₃.

text: Absolute zero of temperature is equal to:
explanation: Absolute zero is 0 K, or about -273 °C.

text: A catalyst increases the rate of a reaction by:
explanation: A catalyst provides an alternative path with lower activation energy and is not consumed.

text: Who is regarded as the father of the Indian nuclear programme?
explanation: Homi J. Bhabha founded the Atomic Energy programme in India.

text: The phrase "scientific temper" was popularised in India by:
explanation: Nehru used the term in "The Discovery of India".

text: In the affective domain taxonomy, the lowest level is:
explanation: The order is receiving, responding, valuing, organisation, characterisation.

text: The science process skill of grouping objects by their common properties is:
explanation: Classifying sorts things by shared properties.

text: "Learning by doing" is the educational idea most closely associated with:
explanation: Dewey advocated experiential, activity-based learning.

text: In a constructivist science class, the teacher first:
options: Finds out the pupils' prior ideas
explanation: Prior knowledge is the starting point for new understanding.

text: The introduction of a lesson should mainly:
options: Motivate pupils and link with previous knowledge
explanation: A good introduction arouses interest and recalls earlier learning.

text: Which Indian satellite is dedicated to educational broadcasting?
explanation: EDUSAT was launched in 2004 for educational services.

text: Which of the following belongs to the information processing family of teaching models?
explanation: Concept attainment, inductive thinking and advance organiser models belong to the information processing family.

text: In the 5E model, the "Elaborate" phase asks pupils to:
options: Extend their understanding to new situations
explanation: Elaboration applies the concept to new contexts.

text: In the scientific method, a tentative explanation that can be tested is called a:
explanation: A hypothesis is a testable proposed explanation.

text: The assignment method in science is used mainly to:
explanation: Assignments extend learning beyond the class through independent work.

text: The investigatory method is mainly a:
options: Learner-centred method of finding answers by investigation
explanation: Learners plan and carry out investigations to answer questions.

text: The problem-solving approach in science teaching mainly develops:
options: Reasoning and the ability to apply knowledge
explanation: It trains pupils to define, investigate and solve problems.

text: A child-centred curriculum is one that:
options: Is based on the interests and needs of learners
explanation: Its content and activities are chosen around learners' needs and interests.

text: Good illustrations in a science textbook:
explanation: Clear diagrams and pictures support understanding.

text: Field trips organised by a science club help pupils to:
options: Observe and learn from nature directly
explanation: Direct experience in the field makes learning meaningful.

text: A criterion-referenced test judges a student's performance against:
explanation: It checks whether the learner has reached a set criterion.

text: Short-answer questions are mainly useful for testing:
options: Recall and brief explanation of facts
explanation: They require brief, precise answers.

text: The teacher's role in curriculum development is to:
explanation: Teachers contribute practical feedback and ideas for improving the curriculum.
